RaceName: Knight Frank East Anglia Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Normally races over 6f/7f but has form at 1m; usually runs in Class 4; gained last three wins at the Newmarket tracks; inconsistent in 2026 but this represents a drop back in grade, off an attractive mark to boot.

RaceName: Knight Frank East Anglia Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Record is only 1-15; however, gained the success the last time he wore headgear (cheekpieces on final start for previous yard); fairly consistent this year; interesting in first-time visor.

RaceName: Knight Frank East Anglia Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Rallied well in first-time visor dropped back to 1m at Sandown (good to firm) last week, opening his account at the seventh attempt; incurs 6lb penalty but Toby Moore takes off 7lb; may build on that win and improve further; respected in the retained headgear.

RaceName: Knight Frank East Anglia Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Exposed mare who is often slowly away; however, her form at the Newmarket July course features a success (over 7f) last summer and close third (over 1m) last week; may remain competitive.

RaceName: Knight Frank East Anglia Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Four-race maiden who showed some improvement with 40-1 fourth of six at Sandown (7f; turf/handicap debut) most recently; chance of winning depends on whether he can build on that effort.

RaceName: Knight Frank East Anglia Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Ran respectably, albeit without being able to justify favouritism, at Chepstow latest start and is back on last winning mark; however, he's a quirky sort who comes with some risk; steps back up in class.

RaceName: Knight Frank East Anglia Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Four-race maiden who has shown steady improvement, close third in 7f handicap on the turf course at Lingfield most recently; may take another step forward, provided she stays this new trip; shortlisted.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Bexhill On Sea Apprentice Classified Stakes
OwnerName: P And Mrs L Rowe And John Turner
Spotlight: Unplaced all four starts for new stable this season but was denied a clear run when fourth in this grade here (6f, good to firm) two starts ago and is probably worth another crack at 7f; could have a say.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Bexhill On Sea Apprentice Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Has become unreliable and was soundly beaten on latest outing a fortnight ago but won similar race to this over C&D (good) in June and has obvious claims if able to replicate that form.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Bexhill On Sea Apprentice Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Won in this grade at Bath (5.7f, good) in June but two lesser efforts have followed (6f/5f) and he's not yet proven over this far; not an easy one to predict.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Bexhill On Sea Apprentice Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 8yo who has worked his way back into form this season and he won a 1m classified here yesterday under Molly Gunn, which was his sixth course win; strong claims under 4lb penalty if running again today.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Bexhill On Sea Apprentice Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 21-race maiden who was safely held when sixth in this grade here (1m) yesterday behind River Wharfe; he clearly needs to raise his game.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Bexhill On Sea Apprentice Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Yet to add to her 2yo win but was runner-up twice in this grade in June, latterly over C&D (good to firm); didn't enjoy the run of the race when dropped back to 5.7f at Bath on Friday; might be the answer.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Bexhill On Sea Apprentice Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Still a maiden after 32 starts and sometimes races too freely but was respectable third in this grade at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) in June, after a break, and ought to be suited by this move back up in trip.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Bexhill On Sea Apprentice Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Gained four of his five wins at this track (two over 7f) but has largely been disappointing over the last couple of year and hopes of him adding to his tally are beginning to fade.

RaceName: Knight Frank Suffolk Heritage Nursery Handicap
OwnerName: Sarah Fern, Patricia James And Partner
Spotlight: Good second at Lingfield (nursery debut) last time when bidding for a 7f AW double; likely to be suited by 1m and may be capable of better still; solid-looking claims back on turf.

RaceName: Knight Frank Suffolk Heritage Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Two from two since switched to nurseries, sent beyond sprint trips and wearing cheekpieces; raised 8lb for Leicester win (7f, good to firm) last time but may improve further; respected.

RaceName: Knight Frank Suffolk Heritage Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Thrice-raced colt who has been steadily getting the hang of things, midfield at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) most recently; may take a bigger step forward now handicapping; possibilities.

RaceName: Knight Frank Suffolk Heritage Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Thrice-raced colt who isn't entirely solid returned to turf; chance depends on whether the much improved form of his 40-1 success in Newcastle maiden (7f; AW debut) is backed up.

RaceName: Knight Frank Suffolk Heritage Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who has been improving gradually, running-on fifth under 5lb claimer at Epsom (7f) most recently; could blossom in nurseries; interesting with fully-fledged rider back on board.

RaceName: JenningsBet Ladies Day Restricted Novice Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Brother to 6f Group 3 winner Sense Of Duty; 80-1, ran green and struggled on recent debut at Glorious Goodwood (6f, good); this race is easier but he still needs to take a big step forward.

RaceName: JenningsBet Ladies Day Restricted Novice Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Shaped with promise when fifth of 11 at Salisbury (6f, soft) in June but didn't really build on that performance when sixth of eight at Epsom (7f, good) last month and has a bit to find with a couple of these.

RaceName: JenningsBet Ladies Day Restricted Novice Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Finished about 3l behind The Monkey King when fifth of ten on debut at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) 19 days ago but his inexperience was evident there and he ought to get much closer to the target here.

RaceName: JenningsBet Ladies Day Restricted Novice Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Groves Martin Parker Walsh And Williams
Spotlight: 10,000gns foal; 11th foal; brother to a Swedish 6f/1m winner, closely related to 1m-1m2f winner Menai Bridge (including 2yo; RPR 94), half-brother to four winners including Heroics (1m6f; 76); dam unplaced 7f-1m2f (58); market support will bring him into the equation.

RaceName: JenningsBet Ladies Day Restricted Novice Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Well-bred gelding who bettered his encouraging debut when third of ten at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) last month; that form sets the standard here and he probably has more improvement to come; respected.

RaceName: Knight Frank Woodbridge EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: £58,000 yearling; promising second, behind subsequent nursery scorer, in 6f maiden at Nottingham (good to firm) where he was the sole newcomer in a field of five; sets the form standard.

RaceName: Knight Frank Woodbridge EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Raced on the front end en route to fading in 7f contest at Doncaster, finishing sixth of ten; may improve dropped in distance with that outing under his belt.

RaceName: Knight Frank Woodbridge EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Cotai Glory half-brother to 7f/1m winner Beyond The Bar (RPR 77), out of Group-placed 6f scorer (including 2yo; 98); Hannon newcomer who looks one of the likelier types.

RaceName: Knight Frank Woodbridge EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: £40,000 yearling; Bated Breath half-brother to 7f winner Jungle Knight (RPR 62); dam once-raced daughter of useful 7f 2yo scorer; caution is advised with 7lb claimer booked on debut.

RaceName: Knight Frank Woodbridge EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: £11,000 yearling, £37,000 (breeze-up) 2yo; by Sergei Prokofiev out of unraced half-sister to smart winners Saayerr (6f 2yo Group 2) and Ornate (prolific 5f including 2yo); Billy Loughnane is a positive booking; interesting debutant.

RaceName: Knight Frank Woodbridge EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 48,000gns yearling; by Kingman; sibling to three winners, notably Extra Elusive (1m-1m4f including 2yo/AW/Group 3; 118) and Ajaya (5.4f/6f 2yo including Group 2; RPR 113); dam unraced; sole filly in the field; adds interest, being nicely bred.

RaceName: Knight Frank Woodbridge EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Hold My Beer, M Broughton & T Elphick
Spotlight: 10,000gns foal, 16,000gns yearling; Harry Angel half-brother to 7f-1m2f winner Storm Asset (RPR 64), out of 6f/7f scorer (including German Listed; 99); others have stronger-looking claims.

RaceName: Jenningsbet In Hastings Handicap
Spotlight: Dual 7f AW winner in second half of last year but returned from layoff with two low-key turf runs in June/July (7f/7.3f); on a good mark now and might have untapped potential over 1m but others in this line-up have less to prove.

RaceName: Jenningsbet In Hastings Handicap
Spotlight: Has somewhat mixed record since joining this stable about a year ago but won on Tapeta (1m2f) in March and posted good effort when keeping-on third at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) a fortnight ago; still on a workable mark; must be considered.

RaceName: Jenningsbet In Hastings Handicap
Spotlight: Dual course winner, latterly over 1m2f (good to firm) last month; travelled well for a long way when fourth in higher-grade company at Sandown (1m, good to firm; refitted cheekpieces) a fortnight ago and is of strong interest back at this track.

RaceName: Jenningsbet In Hastings Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice on AW (1m2f/9.4f) in early part of this year and has made the frame five consecutive times (1m-1m2f) since returned to turf in the spring; holds no secrets from the handicapper and may be better suited by 1m2f but ought to give another good account.

RaceName: Jenningsbet In Hastings Handicap
Spotlight: Largely consistent 9yo who ended a lengthy losing run when dead-heating at Lingfield (7f, AW) in February and comes here after a pretty good second at Windsor (1m, good to firm) last month; suited by this track; likely contender.

RaceName: Jenningsbet In Hastings Handicap
Spotlight: Five-time winner (5f-7f) when based in Ireland; attracted stewards' attention when never-dangerous seventh on last month's stable debut at Wolverhampton (5f, AW); might well come good for Richard Hughes soon but his stamina for 1m is unproven and he's quite tricky to weigh up at the moment.

RaceName: Knight Frank Cambridge Connections Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Holds a Group 1 entry and he's the clear form pick in this field, having won a maiden then finished second in Listed contest, both over 7f on the other course at Newmarket (good/good to firm) in the spring.

RaceName: Knight Frank Cambridge Connections Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Has shown modest form in bumpers and over hurdles; tailed-off last of four in 7f novice event at Leicester last week on Flat debut.

RaceName: Knight Frank Cambridge Connections Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Both starts at Lingfield, better effort when front-running fourth over 1m on AW last time; well below the standard set by the form horse in this field.

RaceName: Knight Frank Cambridge Connections Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 5,000gns 3yo; by Kingman and first foal of 1m2f winner (RPR 86) who is closely related to 1m Group 2 scorer Prague; sole newcomer in a race that features a useful colt.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Basingstoke Brighton Challenge Cup Handicap (The Brighton Challenge Cup) (GBBPlus)
Spotlight: Versatile 8yo who ran well in two chases this spring and returned to the Flat with game win from the front at Chester (1m4f, good) last month; nudged up only 1lb for that and can make another bold bid here.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Basingstoke Brighton Challenge Cup Handicap (The Brighton Challenge Cup) (GBBPlus)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late K W Bell
Spotlight: Ran big race in defeat over C&D (good to firm) in May and is still well handicapped but ought to have been suited by the soft ground when soundly beaten at Goodwood (1m6f) in June and has become far too inconsistent to rely upon.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Basingstoke Brighton Challenge Cup Handicap (The Brighton Challenge Cup) (GBBPlus)
Spotlight: Fast-improving 4yo who needed only to be pushed out to win four-runner contest at Newbury (1m4f, good to firm) a fortnight ago and is now 3-4 for current stable (including a C&D win); makes obvious appeal.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Basingstoke Brighton Challenge Cup Handicap (The Brighton Challenge Cup) (GBBPlus)
Spotlight: Revitalised 6yo who is on a hat-trick after two 1m2f course wins in June (good/good to firm); moves up from Class 6 today but this longer trip is probably in his favour and he remains well handicapped on older form.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Basingstoke Brighton Challenge Cup Handicap (The Brighton Challenge Cup) (GBBPlus)
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden; second of five in tactical race at Epsom last month and didn't run badly when third of five at Doncaster (also 1m4f, good to firm) nine days later, despite racing too freely, but others in this line-up have more pressing claims.

RaceName: Knight Frank Eastern Counties Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Dual 1m4f winner; ran creditably (clear fourth) back over 1m6f last time, while leaving the impression 2m is worth a go; possibilities, provided he takes well to first-time cheekpieces (has form in blinkers/visor).

RaceName: Knight Frank Eastern Counties Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Hasn't scored under this code since his French days in 2022 but looks interesting with usual visor removed, having gained all wins (Flat/hurdles) without headgear; yard also runs High Fibre.

RaceName: Knight Frank Eastern Counties Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Form for new yard comprises a staying-on third at York (1m4f; first Flat start since 2024) and career-best success, with visor applied, in notable 2m handicap hurdle at Market Rasen; may have more to offer in the retained headgear; respected.

RaceName: Knight Frank Eastern Counties Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: On a long losing sequence, being 0-21 since debut win; however, beat all bar a subsequent scorer last time, over 1m6f at Chester, and appears to hold a fighting chance off the same mark, which is 22lb lower than his peak one.

RaceName: Knight Frank Eastern Counties Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Four-race maiden who has consistent form figures; creditable second, behind thriving rival, in three-runner handicap at Newbury (1m5f) most recently; in excellent hands and may still have progress in her; the least exposed contender and receives plenty of weight all round.

RaceName: Westcare Home Care Claiming Hurdle
OwnerName: Nigel O'Hare & Mark Devlin & Philip Smith
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden over hurdles; second of 14 in Downpatrick handicap in June, but well beaten when favourite back there last month; stiff task at the weights.

RaceName: Westcare Home Care Claiming Hurdle
Spotlight: Has won six races for local yard, four hurdles and two chases; hasn't competed much in this discipline since winning at Kilbeggan nearly two years ago; good run over fences at Tramore in May, poor since.

RaceName: Westcare Home Care Claiming Hurdle
Spotlight: Grand dual-purpose performer has done a lot more Flat racing than hurdling in recent years; had Oh So Charming and Warm In Gorey behind when winning one of these at Wexford in May; 10l third to ready winner Raydamann over C&D the following month, and 4lb pull may not be enough to turn things around.

RaceName: Westcare Home Care Claiming Hurdle
Spotlight: Was in better form last year when winning at Limerick over hurdles and on the Flat; struggled over hurdles subsequently and this will be his first run over flights since October; regressive on the level this year, although fair effort last time at Killarney.

RaceName: Westcare Home Care Claiming Hurdle
Spotlight: Three wins over hurdles; made the running when around 9l off Rich Belief at Wexford in June, and extra 7lb claimed now; backed that up when placed in Downpatrick handicap, but well beaten latest.

RaceName: Westcare Home Care Claiming Hurdle
Spotlight: Did well in handicaps last summer, winning over 2m6f and placed three times; had a couple of spins over fences in early summer; going okay when departing four out in 3m claimer at Roscommon, poor run since; no weight and big chance on paper, but would prefer farther.

RaceName: Westcare Home Care Claiming Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a handicap off 111 last year, so has come down a lot in the ratings; has run in several claimers and was second of five in this last year; chased home Rich Belief at Wexford in May, held in handicaps since.

RaceName: Westcare Home Care Claiming Hurdle
Spotlight: AW winner over 1m6f; modest hurdles form in three maidens and a handicap, and holds the lowest rating of these; visor on for the first time over jumps.

RaceName: Westcare Home Care Claiming Hurdle
OwnerName: Ed Mulligan & John Finnegan & Aileen Saunders & Ann Holton
Spotlight: Modest hurdles form; won heavy-ground chase at Ayr during the winter; well beaten lately, including in Galway festival chase latest; third runner for yard.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
Spotlight: Gleneagles colt; E120,000 yearling; dam 1m winner (RPR 87), half-sister to winners Helvezia (7f) and Caballero (7f 2yo), is granddaughter of Listed-placed 1m winner; yard going well and can ready one, so check the market.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
OwnerName: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith
Spotlight: Wootton Bassett colt was 14-1 when finishing last of six on debut at the Curragh last month, but he was only 5l behind the winner; looks almost certain to improve with Ryan Moore taking over in the plate and can't be discounted.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
Spotlight: Frankel colt made an encouraging start at Killarney when a 0.5l second and he had a subsequent maiden winner 2.75l behind; should have learned plenty that day and sets the standard.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
Spotlight: Ghaiyyath colt; 100,000gns yearling; dam French 10.5f winner, sister to useful 1m-1m2f winner Spiorad, out of 6f 2yo winning half-sister to 6f Group 3 winner Lightning Moon; yard in top form and likely type on paper; check the market.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
Spotlight: 10-1 on debut at Killarney and was beaten 8.5l after missing the break; will need to improve plenty on that effort to feature here and Francillon looks yard's main hope.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
Spotlight: Churchill gelding; E47,000 yearling; dam 1m winner (RPR 92), half-sister to winners Love Lockdown (6f 2yo Group 3) and Chosen Character (useful 7f-1m), out of 1m2f winner; market best guide on debut.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
Spotlight: Ten Sovereigns colt; dam 1m 2yo winner (RPR 92), half-sister to 5f winner Crombay, out of unraced half-sister to Swedish 1m/1m4f Listed winner Highway; yard in form but yet to have a juvenile winner this season.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
OwnerName: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor
Spotlight: Sea The Stars colt; 1,000,000gns foal; dam twice-raced half-sister to winners I Can Fly (1m Group 2) and Viscount Barfield (7f Listed), out of maiden half-sister to French 2,000 Guineas winner Landseer; Moore prefers stablemate, but no surprise to see this expensive purchase show up well on debut.

RaceName: JenningsBet Top Staff Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Three-time AW winner but not since March 2025, and his record on turf is poor; last off four in Lingfield handicap (1m6f, good to firm) 12 days ago and not the percentage call here.

RaceName: JenningsBet Top Staff Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Gave short-odds favourite a fright when second of four here (1m2f, good to firm; first-time blinkers) in June but was soundly beaten on his other four starts for Tony Carroll this year and his latest win was in 2023.

RaceName: JenningsBet Top Staff Classified Stakes
OwnerName: M Robinson, Jack Pook & Jeanette May
Spotlight: Won this race in 2024 and collected another fast-ground C&D win last summer; nearly 6l behind Gearing's Point when keeping-on third in similar race to this here in June but still features prominently in calculations.

RaceName: JenningsBet Top Staff Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Seven-race maiden; shaped quite well when fifth of 14 in Windsor handicap (11.4f, good to firm) in May and may not have been suited by the good to soft ground when well held there in June; worth a second look.

RaceName: JenningsBet Top Staff Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 12-race maiden; fairly consistent in nurseries last summer (7f-1m) but has struggled to make an impact off her basement handicap mark this year (four runs; 1m-1m4f).

RaceName: Corinthian Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Two Sandown wins under David Dunsdon in 2025, including this race on good (other win on good to firm); back on form returned to turf and reunited with his owner/rider when seeing off seven rivals at Goodwood (1m, soft) eight weeks ago; raised 6lb but his good record in these races affords him plenty of respect.

RaceName: Corinthian Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to add to his Group 3 win at Glorious Goodwood three years ago but placed several times this year, including third at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) on Saturday; prior to that he was beaten only a neck over 1m4f at Epsom (good to firm) under Megan Jordan; tongue-tied first time.

RaceName: Corinthian Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Has a good 10-34 record on AW but his turf strike-rate is only 2-19; has a lower mark in this sphere but off since finishing last of six at Wolverhampton in March and a watching brief is the percentage call.

RaceName: Corinthian Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
OwnerName: Hasmonean Racing, S Hope & S Barrow
Spotlight: Well-related gelding who has shown a fairly useful level of ability when third in maiden/novice events over 1m (good/good to firm) this year; while it's tough to argue an opening mark in the 80s looks generous he's unexposed and his pedigree suggests this longer trip will help; also visored first time.

RaceName: Corinthian Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
OwnerName: John & Peter Seabrook And Tim Fisher
Spotlight: Won twice over C&D (good/soft) last summer; has reached the frame on four of his five 2026 starts but beaten 6l when fourth at York latest and the return to Sandown needs to help him recapture his peak form.

RaceName: Corinthian Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Tailed off on hurdle/yard debut last autumn but proved a different proposition after a break when successful back on the Flat at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) in May, pulling over 4l clear and posting his peak RPR; evidently capable when fresh so being off for a further three months isn't a concern but he'll require another career best off 7lb higher.

RaceName: Corinthian Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: AW maiden winner and has shown better form in defeat in handicaps this year, beaten at short odds but running his best RPR when second of four at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; likely to go well.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div I)
OwnerName: D Bishop, S Bland & T Coyle
Spotlight: Ten-race maiden; didn't run badly when fifth of seven at Beverley (8.5f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) two starts back but he was well held at Ripon 19 days ago; dropped another 2lb and not dismissed at this level.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Tailed off on her debut at Newmarket (1m, good; hooded) in April when trained by Des Donovan and she was well beaten in two starts on the AW over 7f last month; steps back up in trip on handicap debut with better needed.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Well held on her first two handicaps (1m/1m4f) and she faded into sixth having controlled the pace in a maiden at Wolverhampton (9.5f, AW; first-time blinkers) 39 days ago; returns to handicap company and others are preferred.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Posted an improved effort when holding on to win by a head at Wolverhampton (7f, AW; made all) 16 days ago, getting off the mark at the sixth attempt; this extra furlong is a slight concern but he has claims if seeing it out; only 3lb higher.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: 12-race maiden but he did finish runner-up on the AW three times for his previous stable (all in cheekpieces which are off today); missed the break and never featured in race won by Distillation at Wolverhampton (7f) 16 days ago; possibilities back up in trip.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Won off this mark at Leicester (7f, soft) last October and was subsequently gelded; well beaten in three starts this year and on his only previous try on the AW; others preferred.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Posted an RPR of 54 on her debut at Catterick (7f, good) in April but she's not built on that in four starts since, including two handicaps (1m/6f); steps back up in trip with a bit to prove on her AW debut.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Respectable fourth of seven in a classified event at Yarmouth (1m2f, good to firm) in June but she didn't build on that at Brighton (1m2f) last month; drops back to 1m and returns to handicap company; others stronger.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Beaten about 2l when sixth of nine on his handicap debut at Doncaster (7f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) but he's been well beaten in both starts since; steps up to 1m with much better needed.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Huge prices and has struggled in each of his three starts (6f-8.5f; AW/good to firm); big step forward needed on his handicap debut.

RaceName: Knight Frank Handicap
Spotlight: Eventually drew clear from two rivals at Yarmouth (1m6f, good to firm) last week, having taken a while to respond to Billy Loughnane's urgings; previously effective over 1m4f and, even with 4lb penalty, remains well treated on peak form.

RaceName: Knight Frank Handicap
Spotlight: Retains plenty of ability aged nine, having finished a close second in two of his three outings this term, latest at Sandown; was still capable of winning races last summer and can't be ruled out.

RaceName: Knight Frank Handicap
Spotlight: Ran creditably, keeping on, last time when bidding for a Nottingham double (1m2f; maiden previously); remains in form and, as his dam's side confirms, looks worth another crack at 1m4f; respected.

RaceName: Knight Frank Handicap
Spotlight: Quite lightly raced 5yo maiden; creditable third, one place behind Educator, at Windsor (11.5f) in sole Flat start this year; a possible danger provided that form is backed up.

RaceName: Knight Frank Handicap
Spotlight: Five-race maiden who is very nicely bred, being a son of Frankel and from the family of Dubawi; ran well (neck second) over 1m2f on the turf track at Lingfield on handicap debut; behind Didaar at Nottingham since but may do better still; steps up in trip.

RaceName: Knight Frank Handicap
Spotlight: Has finished last in small-field handicaps this term, failing to back up her 2025 maiden form; something to prove and is best watched unless the market suggests a turnaround is likely.

RaceName: Martin Reilly Hyundai Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Beaten 22l and 38l in bumpers; half-brother is a useful jumper for Nicky Henderson, so she might improve for obstacles.

RaceName: Martin Reilly Hyundai Mares Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: Dermot J Kelly & E J Burns & Sandra C Kelly
Spotlight: Runner-up three times in bumpers here (lost one in the stewards' room last time); probably ran to a mid-90s mark in sole hurdles start over C&D in May (third and fifth have won since) and a reproduction may well be good enough.

RaceName: Martin Reilly Hyundai Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Big prices and big margins of defeat in three maidens.

RaceName: Martin Reilly Hyundai Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Poet's Word homebred out of 2m5f-3m hurdle/chase winner; tailed off in a bumper at Thurles in December.

RaceName: Martin Reilly Hyundai Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: 1-9 in point-to-points; poor form in first two starts over hurdles; now tried in a combination of headgear.

RaceName: Martin Reilly Hyundai Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Hillstar mare has decent pedigree, but Flat form in 11 starts couldn't be much worse; hurdles debut.

RaceName: Martin Reilly Hyundai Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Not a bad run when fourth in a Limerick bumper, beaten 15l; didn't build on that last time; first run over jumps and dam and grandam were fair hurdlers.

RaceName: Martin Reilly Hyundai Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Getaway half-sister to 2m-2m4f hurdle winner Morricone; dam bumper winner, half-sister to useful bumper and 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase winner Encore Champs, out of Irish Cesarewitch winner and useful hurdler Dani California; took a walk in the market and looked clueless early on when tailed off in 2m4f maiden at Roscommon.

RaceName: Martin Reilly Hyundai Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Has ability and no bigger than 9-1 in three bumpers, but she's keen-going and tricky; beaten 24l in fourth at Punchestown in January; refused to race next time; too free when well beaten at Wexford; will need to settle better on hurdling debut.

RaceName: Martin Reilly Hyundai Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Modest maiden on the Flat, but has run well at times on testing ground; hurdling debut.

RaceName: Martin Reilly Hyundai Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Blue Bresil filly only cost E2,000 as 3yo, but has a decent pedigree; dam dual bumper winner, closely related to 1m4f Flat and smart 2m-3m hurdle winner Fire Dragon, half-sister to 1m5f Group 3 winner Spendent and smart 2m hurdler Rigmarole.

RaceName: Martin Reilly Hyundai Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Tailed off in Cork maiden hurdle last month.

RaceName: Martin Reilly Hyundai Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: From a top yard, but has been tailed off in maidens at Ballinrobe and Kilbeggan.

RaceName: Wasdell Group Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Got competitive some way out at Salisbury last time (1m2f, good to firm) and was mugged on the line; respected off 1lb higher, for all that he's yet to prove his stamina for this far.

RaceName: Wasdell Group Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Six-time winner, latterly in comfortable fashion at the expense of three rivals at Salisbury (1m6f, good to firm); strongly considered off 4lb higher; Charlie Tucker claims 7lb, replacing Oisin Murphy.

RaceName: Wasdell Group Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time Flat winner (1m1f-1m4f) in Ireland and was also placed over jumps; however, brought down early and pulled up in two maiden hurdles for current yard and a visor replaces usual cheekpieces.

RaceName: Wasdell Group Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Turf wins this season at Bath (1m), over C&D and Leicester (1m2f); ran well from off the pace at Ascot 12 days ago (1m4f); her good campaign could continue.

RaceName: Wasdell Group Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner in July on second run for this yard and followed up again here over 1m2f; kept on for a 3l fourth at Sandown (1m2f) and returning to this trip will suit; 4lb higher than last time.

RaceName: Wasdell Group Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Beaten under 3l when upped to 1m4f for handicap debut at Salisbury (good to firm) and should have more to offer.

RaceName: Wasdell Group Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Improved for the hood when close up in his final novice in May (1m2f, good to firm) but was then tailed off on his handicap debut (1m4f); now gelded and needs respecting on the strength of that penultimate effort.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: 28-1 and failed to land a blow in a Down Royal maiden 20 days ago; may need a bit more time and experience.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Wootton Bassett gelding; E400,000 yearling; dam 6f 2yo winner (RPR 96), sister to 1m Listed winner/Irish 1,000 Guineas third So Wonderful and Group-placed 7f/1m2f winner Antilles; fifth in Naas barrier trial and three of the four ahead of him have since been placed in maidens; overlooked by McMonagle but not discounted.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Slowly away and no show on debut at the Curragh (6.5f, good) but much improved at Dundalk (1m) when beaten just 3.75l into fifth of 10; weakened late that day, though, so this longer trip is a query.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Proved odds of 33-1 all wrong when splitting Cape Cod (handicap winner here off 92) and last week's Goodwood Group 3 winner Enceladus on debut at Naas (1m, yielding) last October; has been gelded and now sports cheekpieces; leading form claims if fully fit for return.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Encouraging debut run at Cork in May (10.5f, soft); even better on second start in 3yo race at Navan (1m2f, good) when just 1l behind the 100-rated South Island and 0.75l behind the 98-rated Summer Is Tomorrow; this shorter trip could suit; obvious chance.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Belied odds of 22-1 when a neck runner-up on debut at Dundalk (1m) in December; weakened in the closing stages on first start since over 10.5f back there last month; may have needed that, and bred to act on turf, so not dismissed.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Sea The Stars colt; E130,000 yearling; half-brother to four winners inc Sonnyboyliston (1m-1m6f Flat inc Ebor/Irish St Leger, RPR 121; 2m hurdle) and Lot Of Joy (1m4f-2m Flat, 101; useful 2m-2m2f hurdle); dam 1m7f-2m Flat (78) and 2m3f/2m4f hurdle winner; plenty of appeal on paper and preferred by McMonagle.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: 20-1 and beaten 16.5l on debut at Dundalk last month; major improvement required.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Japanese-bred gelding by Rey De Oro; 9,000gns foal; closely related to Japanese 6.5f/7f dirt winner King Oliver, half-brother to Japanese 7f dirt winner Baleo Ria; dam placed 1m2f turf in Japan, sister to Japanese 1m2f Grade 2 winner Ria Amelia; probably best watched on debut.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
OwnerName: John Maurice Murphy & Michael O Phelan
Spotlight: Arizona gelding; dam 1m2f-1m4f winner (inc AW; RPR 72), half-sister to 1m-10.6f winner Sleepy Head, out of 1m 2yo winning half-sister to 5f 2yo Group 3 winner Morning Pride; best watched unless the market speaks.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Dark Angel gelding; unsold for E190,000gns as a yearling; closely related to two winners inc Dinozzo (1m-1m1f inc 2yo/HK), half-brother to five winners inc Arrest (1m-13.3f inc 2yo/Group 3; 117) and Detain (Group-placed 7f/1m AW inc 2yo; 115); dam unraced; lots to like on paper and yard can ready one; interesting debutant.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Failed to beat a rival on debut at Limerick last month when a 16-1 shot; may need a bit more time.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Soundly beaten on debut at Gowran (9.5f, yielding) and when 66-1 over 1m5f here in June; will get a handicap mark after this.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Waldgeist gelding; E13,000 yearling; half-brother to four winners inc Lime And Lemon (1m2f; RPR 83) and Black Hawk Eagle (1m5f Flat, 83; 1m7f/2m hurdle/chase); dam unraced half-sister to Oaks winner Forever Together and two 1m Group 1 winners; worth a market check on debut with Keane up.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Has beaten just one rival home in small fields at Ballinrobe and Cork; yard in top form but he'll be of more interest when sent handicapping.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Brighton Handicap
Spotlight: Bounced back from below-par run with narrow win at Epsom (7f, good to firm) last month and remains well treated after subsequent 2lb nudge; high on the list.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Brighton Handicap
Spotlight: Generally disappointing since returned to turf in May but seemed to respond well to first-time visor when close second off reduced mark at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; big player if in similar form here.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Brighton Handicap
Spotlight: Resurgent front-runner who has collected five wins (three over C&D) this year; on fairly tough mark now and was soundly beaten at Newmarket on Friday but is sure to be suited by the return to this track.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Brighton Handicap
Spotlight: Fairly reliable 5yo who kept on well for narrow success at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; subsequent 2lb rise is manageable and this longer trip also suits; probably won't be far away.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Brighton Handicap
Spotlight: Always behind on last month's stable debut (5f) but wasn't beaten far when sixth of eight at Windsor (6f, good to firm) a fortnight later; needs to make further progress here but should be fine over this trip and is attractively weighted on best Irish form; market reference recommended.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Brighton Handicap
OwnerName: The Likely Lads & S & A Mares
Spotlight: Dual 6f course winner for Charlie Clover in October; 0-6 for current stable since April but posted sound effort when second of five over C&D (good to firm) in June and is another 1lb lower today.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Far from solid on her 7f novice efforts but may do better now handicapping, upped in trip and fitted with tongue-tie; check the market signals for further guidance.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Building up a better record on AW than on turf and ran creditably at Wolverhampton (the scene of her sole win) most recently; may still have more to offer in this sphere.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Best form when scoring over 6f on AW in February and third over 7f on turf last time; judged solely on breeding, has a stamina doubt upped to 1m.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Has shaped quite encouragingly from off the pace in last two starts but needs improvement to get off the mark and also perhaps requires the cards to drop right.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Five-race maiden who went very close despite major traffic issues in 1m classified event at Thirsk most recently, looking desperately unlucky; respected assuming that improved form is backed up.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Showed improved form when a visor was first fitted; no further progress kept to turf since but today's change of headgear may have positive effect.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Failed to make the frame in turf races; placed in a couple of 8.5f classified contests at Wolverhampton since switched to AW, splitting subsequent winners on the first occasion; solid-looking claims.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Four-race maiden who has weak claims on form; drops back in trip for this second handicap attempt.

RaceName: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Showed signs of improvement in Wolverhampton classified race in sole outing this year but needs to build on that effort.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Well beaten at big odds on first two starts (7f/6f, good) and it's hard to envisage the drop to 5f prompting a transformation.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Recovered from slow start to finish second at 3-1 on recent debut at Lingfield (5f, good to firm); his dam was a useful 5f/6f winner from a talented sprinting family and he's a leading contender on this second run.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beaten a long way on his first two starts (6f, good to firm/AW); the first-time tongue-tie needs to make a massive difference.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Failed to settle and weakened into 8l sixth of nine at 10-1 on recent debut at Ascot (6f, good to firm); however, that run may have got the freshness out of him and he has a useful pedigree; drops to 5f and could get closer to the target today.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Mr And Mrs B V Sangster
Spotlight: Unplaced this summer on his first three starts (all 6f); gelded since latest outing on July 13; others are preferred.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 260,000gns yearling who has been a short-priced favourite for both starts, when seventh at Newbury (6f, good) then fifth at Nottingham (6f, good); gelded since last run and perhaps that will help unlock the potential in his attractive pedigree; interesting to see if he's again strong in the betting.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 82,000gns yearling; fifth foal; Mehmas half-brother to four winners including Diamond Vega (6f-8.5f including 2yo/German Listed) and Marketplaceofideas (US 1m/8.5f turf; RPR 102); dam Listed-placed 5f winner (including 2yo; 92); likely to improve for this debut run but monitor the betting.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Well-backed runner-up on last month's debut at York (6f, good to firm); down the field at Goodwood (7f, good to firm) since but failed to see out the trip in that warm maiden; could be suited by this stiff 5f; respected.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Yard is going well but she's been well beaten over 6f on her first two starts and it's probably best to look elsewhere.

RaceName: Kilcawley Construction Rated Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a bumper in France, but had proved frustrating over hurdles until making all in C&D maiden last month and followed up nine days later in Ballinrobe novice over same trip, produced last to beat an odds-on shot with a fair bit in hand; handles softer ground but good ground seems to suit; has clearly turned a corner and 4yo probably the one to beat again with rider's claim a positive.

RaceName: Kilcawley Construction Rated Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Flat maiden easily got off the mark over hurdles (15th attempt) in a weak Downpatrick maiden over this trip last month (good), having gone close on several occasions in stronger company; major player.

RaceName: Kilcawley Construction Rated Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Flat winner is 0-11 hurdling but runner-up no less than five times (all at 2m), including seasonal return at Punchestown in June; Roscommon run since was below par but overall profile gives him claims.

RaceName: Kilcawley Construction Rated Novice Hurdle
OwnerName: M R D Fleming & G Bruce & J P Ryan & Miss G Ryan
Spotlight: Up front throughout when winning C&D mares' handicap last month (good); similar tactics employed when third to Manoir De Mirande in 2m2f Ballinrobe novice since; 6lb better off before that rival's claim is taken into account.

RaceName: Kilcawley Construction Rated Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Bumper winner as a 4yo for former yard; 0-10 hurdling but just denied in C&D maiden a year ago; form this year not as good, fading tamely in mares' handicap at Galway last week; declining mark but still looks to have a bit to find.

RaceName: Reecer Group Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Has a BHA mark of 67 after five defeats, all at 5f; not progressing and looks vulnerable.

RaceName: Reecer Group Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Mrs Paul Shanahan & Mrs M V Magnier
Spotlight: Dropped back to 5f at Sandown (good to firm) and still appeared to be learning on the job in finishing a close third behind a Haggas newcomer; clear claims.

RaceName: Reecer Group Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Fifth foal; half-sister to 6f/7f AW winner Miss Moonshine (RPR 64); dam unraced half-sister to AW winners Litotes (1m) and Ain't Talkin' (7f); would merit attention if popular in the betting.

RaceName: Reecer Group Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 70,000gns yearling; eighth foal; half-sister to seven winners including Jungle Cove (7f-1m2f; RPR 101; 2m hurdle), Main Desire (5f; 101), Magical Effect (5f-7f; 92) and Mini Magna (5f/5.7f 2yo; 86); dam 6f 2yo winner (95); has to be of interest.

RaceName: Bahrain Turf Club Desmond Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Front-running Lockinge winner in 2024 and Group 2 winner at Goodwood the same year; on a losing run since then and had experienced many reverses before being placed in two Irish 7f Group 3 races this term; made much of the running when second on soft ground here in June; similar scenario when third at the Curragh last month; likely to be in the mix.

RaceName: Bahrain Turf Club Desmond Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Has made the frame several times at Group level since a C&D Listed win 15 months ago; not a betting proposition on account of his 1-17 record in stakes races.

RaceName: Bahrain Turf Club Desmond Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Group 3 winner over 7f at Deauville as a 2yo; lost way last season, back to form this term; runner-up to City Of Memphis in conditions race at Gowran (7f, soft) and won conditions race at Fairyhouse (7f, good); stronger form in defeat here last time, with Isaac Newton in third.

RaceName: Bahrain Turf Club Desmond Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Five handicap wins, including over 1m1f at this venue; has made the frame in two C&D Listed races this season; needs to bounce back from a Curragh failure that saw him finish last of six, with Cowardofthecounty in third.

RaceName: Bahrain Turf Club Desmond Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Smart level of form in three runs at the Curragh last year, competed against the likes of Benvenuto Cellini and Hawk Mountain, including when third of five in the Beresford Stakes; flopped on seasonal debut at Fairyhouse; enjoyed a confidence-boosting win at Limerick; riding plans are positive; hard to be sure if he is worthy of 106 official rating.

RaceName: Bahrain Turf Club Desmond Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Goodwood maiden winner on debut last August (7f, good to soft); creditable run in Group 1 at Saint-Cloud (1m2f, very soft) in October; moderate efforts first two runs this term; back on song when winning a 1m1f Listed race at Navan; doubts raised by two subsequent runs; 1 3/4l behind Cowardofthecounty in the 1m1f Meld Stakes here.

RaceName: Bahrain Turf Club Desmond Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Narrow winner of a maiden over an extended 6f (soft) on his debut at Newbury last October; reappeared in the Greenham at the same venue and emerged with credit in finishing fourth of eight, looking in need of a stronger gallop; still looked raw when running in the 2,000 Guineas, eased when beaten; interesting here if he emerges more mature after three months off.

RaceName: Bahrain Turf Club Desmond Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Won a Naas maiden at 25-1 on debut (1m, good) and confirmed ability when showing a good turn of foot in a slowly-run Gowran conditions race (9.5f good to yielding); stepped up to 1m4f to beat a 108-rated rival in a Group 3 race at Cork; short of room at a crucial stage in the Irish Oaks, ran on well for third; drop to 1m here is hardly orthodox, but she may have the speed to prevail.

RaceName: Simon Davis Big 60th Birthday Bash Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: All four wins have been on AW and last two were over C&D in the spring; remains feasibly treated off only 1lb higher than for her last success and she's run well on turf in last two starts including a near-miss at Wetherby (7f, good to firm); usually comes from off the pace and she's strongly respected back up in trip.

RaceName: Simon Davis Big 60th Birthday Bash Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Has a patchy profile but she's won twice on turf this season including an apprentice handicap at Redcar (1m, good to firm) last Wednesday; 0-7 on AW but she has form over C&D and is a big player off the same mark as last time (due to be 2lb higher in future).

RaceName: Simon Davis Big 60th Birthday Bash Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who signed off for Oliver Cole with good second in a Chelmsford handicap (1m2f, AW) in November; on same mark here but she struggled on her stable debut at Pontefract (1m, good to firm) last month and needs to bounce back after that heavy defeat.

RaceName: Simon Davis Big 60th Birthday Bash Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Triple turf winner who scored at Carlisle (1m, soft) in June and has finished a respectable third at Pontefract in her last two starts; still unexposed on AW and she should be in the mix again back in this sphere.

RaceName: Simon Davis Big 60th Birthday Bash Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Made it second-time lucky when landing a Wolverhampton maiden (9.4f, AW) in June; well-held third when odds-on at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) last time but she took a strong hold in that tactical race and it's still early days for this well-bred filly; could resume her progress now switched to a handicap and she needs a close look on this drop back in trip.

RaceName: Simon Davis Big 60th Birthday Bash Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark at the fifth attempt when beating 12 rivals in a C&D handicap (16-1) ten days ago; has a penalty but she beat a clear second last time and is open to more progress; interesting contender.

RaceName: Simon Davis Big 60th Birthday Bash Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Reappeared with a win in a maiden here (6f) in April but she's been well held in three handicaps since; still has low mileage but she needs to find more at this new trip.

RaceName: Simon Davis Big 60th Birthday Bash Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Won a Kempton handicap (7f, AW) in May but she's been well held at Wolverhampton (9.4f/7f) in her last two starts; now only 1lb higher than for her win but overall record is 1-10 and she needs to get back on track.

RaceName: Simon Davis Big 60th Birthday Bash Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: No progress in four runs for Jessica Harrington and was only fourth of five on her stable debut at Hamilton (8.3f, good to firm) last month; dropped another 2lb but she needs to raise her game on this switch to AW.

RaceName: Simon Davis Big 60th Birthday Bash Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: 0-11 but she made a bold bid when a close second in a Wolverhampton handicap (8.6f, Tapeta) two weeks ago; back up 4lb in the weights but she was clear of the third last time and that was a personal best; shortlisted.

RaceName: Simon Davis Big 60th Birthday Bash Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Beaten 7l or more in five runs for James Ferguson including two handicaps (1m2f/1m); still early days but she needs a transformation back on AW for new yard; cheekpieces worn last time are removed.

RaceName: Chasemore Farm EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Showed ability when fifth of eight at Leicester (7f, good) in June on his second start and the step up to 1m could suit this Camelot colt, but he takes on two very interesting newcomers and could again prove vulnerable.

RaceName: Chasemore Farm EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 1,000,000gns yearling; eighth foal; closely related to 7f 2yo winner Victory Dance (including Listed), half-brother to four winners including Skitter Scatter (5f-7f 2yo including Group 1) and Skellet (7f/1m including 2yo/Listed); in top hands and this Too Darn Hot newcomer could play a leading role.

RaceName: Chasemore Farm EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Fourth foal; Sea The Stars brother to Group-placed 7f 2yo winner Macduff (RPR 106), half-brother to 1m3f AW winner Participle (86); dam 1m winner (93), half-sister to top-class miler Kingman, out of French 1,000 Guineas winner; trainer has won two of the last five runnings with newcomers who went on to win Group races; firmly in calculations on debut.

RaceName: Chasemore Farm EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 70,000gns yearling whose dam is from a classy family; green and tailed off when 12-1 on debut at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) in June; can leave that behind at some point but he may be best watched today.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Fourth in handicaps at Clonmel (extended 2m) and when favourite over extended 2m4f here last month; no extra in straight then, and drop back in trip might help.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Two wins over fences; just 1-34 over hurdles, but placed many times; touched off over 2m4f at Killarney this time last year; quiet so far this season and would prefer farther.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a couple of hurdles at four; second three times in a row in handicaps between this trip and 2m4f in April/May and okay runs over fences since; cheekpieces swapped for visor.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Has shown promise over C&D last two starts; fourth in claimer on final start for previous yard and well-backed third in higher grade of handicap last month, when wrong at the weights; had placed form on testing ground in points; new headgear combination.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Both wins have been here, maiden over this trip and 2m4f handicap last time on her fourth outing of the summer; up 7lb for that.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Not shamed in a bumper and three completed starts in maidens; respected yard and he's a possible improver in handicaps.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Grand mare rattled up a hat-trick on the Flat last year and one of her two wins over hurdles came here in 2024; third of seven in C&D mares' handicap hurdle before a poor run in 1m6f Galway handicap which she won last year.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: T Leopold, P Smith, D P Connolly & C Connolly
Spotlight: Maiden has been placed just once in 14 starts over hurdles, when third on winter ground at Navan in December; beaten 18l when fifth at Kilbeggan.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Sole win in 35 starts over hurdles came first time out last year when he won C&D handicap by 10 lengths; lost form towards the end of last season; not a bad run here in June when mid-field behind subsequent dual Galway winner Timurshah.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Placed in three handicaps last August at up to 2m6f; 10l winner over this trip at Downpatrick in June; held when favourite twice since; good ground is important to her.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Interesting trainer/rider combination but filly has shown little so far; wasn't too far off the leaders when walking through the second-last at Roscommon last time.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Poor form for Gordon Elliott and in two starts since returning to his breeder; has been wearing a hood, new headgear combination tried now.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Has been getting better with each handicap run this term, and only beaten 8l over 2m4f here last time (third won since, Go To Town fourth) when O'Keeffe rode her for the first time; travelled into it well that day and this trip might suit better.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Poor form in bumpers and maidens and has been off almost seven months; handicap debut.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Modest form for two previous trainers; much-improved in first-time blinkers on second start for yard when winning at Wexford (2m1f, good) but weakened and beaten 11l when favourite on return to that venue; scratched (due to soft ground) from chase at Roscommon on Tuesday.

RaceName: SIS Handicap Hurdle

RaceName: Ballyroan Stakes (Group 3)

RaceName: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (B/C/D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/GBBPlus)

RaceName: Mulhern Leonard Chartered Accountants Maiden Hurdle

RaceName: Mulhern Leonard Chartered Accountants Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Nothing so far on the Flat and in three attempts over hurdles in Ballinrobe maidens.

RaceName: Carnival de Leop Handicap

RaceName: Carnival de Leop Handicap

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap (Div I)

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap (Div I)

RaceName: Lighthouse At Clifford Electrical Handicap Hurdle

Spotlight: Best run this term came over 1m here in May, staying on from the back for a 3l second; 1lb lower now but has to bounce back from two below-par efforts at Limerick and Naas.

RaceName: Renault Ireland Handicap
Spotlight: A winner of ten races on AW and turf at 7f-1m; hasn't won on grass since August 2022 but did go close over 1m here in April off 4lb lower; has never won over this far a trip.

RaceName: Renault Ireland Handicap
Spotlight: Four-time AW winner; sole success on turf came in 2021; ran on well over 7f at Naas latest, beaten just 2l; step up in trip a plus on that evidence and runs off the same mark; place chance.

RaceName: Renault Ireland Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win came over this trip at Tipperary last season off 5lb lower; not the clearest of runs when 1.5l behind Bella Colombia at Killarney latest; nudged up 2lb and wide draw not ideal, but weighted to reverse that Killarney form and enters calculations.

RaceName: Renault Ireland Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden's best runs this term have come over 1m6f at Gowran and 2m at Listowel; weakened over 14.5f at Killarney on latest; worth a go at this sort of trip but needs more.

RaceName: Renault Ireland Handicap
Spotlight: 3yo showed minor promise in maidens; far from disgraced on handicap debut at the Curragh (1m2f, gd-fm), beaten 4.5l in much better race than this; eased 2lb and could go well dropped back slightly in trip.

RaceName: Renault Ireland Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to add to 2yo success for Ralph Beckett; heavy defeats all three starts this year; mark tumbling but she needs a revival.

RaceName: Renault Ireland Handicap
Spotlight: Dual-purpose; completed quickfire hat-trick on the Flat last summer at around 1m4f; remains 3lb above the last of those wins and was pulled up over hurdles when last seen at Tramore in May; others appeal more.

RaceName: Renault Ireland Handicap
Spotlight: Down the field in three maidens at 6f-1m; could improve for switch to handicaps and worth a market check.

RaceName: Renault Ireland Handicap
Spotlight: Has winning form at this trip and is 6lb lower than when winning at Navan (1m2f, good) just over a year ago; however, badly out of sorts in three runs this term and not easy to fancy on recent form.

RaceName: Renault Ireland Handicap
Spotlight: Ordinary form in maidens at around 1m4f on good ground and on the AW; bred to do better at some stage and makes handicap debut with yard in form, so check the market.

RaceName: Renault Ireland Handicap
Spotlight: Didn't show a whole lot in maidens last year and similar story so far in handicaps; beaten 7.25l when seventh of 11 at Dundalk (7f) on latest; not an obvious candidate for this longer trip on breeding.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap (Div II)
OwnerName: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
Spotlight: He's struggled to get competitive on turf on his four starts since May, albeit he fared best in the near-side group at York a fortnight ago; Tapeta seems to be his preferred surface and he's 5lb lower than when going close at Wolverhampton (7f) in February; no surprise to see a big run.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap (Div II)
OwnerName: Mrs C M Clarke, Foulrice Park Racing Ltd
Spotlight: Won at Doncaster (5.6f, good to firm) last month and runner-up at Pontefract (6f, good to firm) next time, splitting a well-treated winner and a next-time-out scorer; well beaten at York last time but was scuppered by a high draw; third over C&D in April and could be involved.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Off the mark over C&D in April on her eighth start and creditable second at Leicester (6f, good to firm) next time; this lightly raced 4yo can be bang there if returning from a break in the same good form.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Only sixth at Newcastle (5f, AW) last time but placed over 5f on his other three starts this season; his three wins have come over 6f and he could have a part to play back up in trip; effective here.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: 8yo who has been beaten ten times since his last win in July 2024 but he's been placed on both starts this summer (6f, soft/Tapeta); chance.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Beaten on his last 12 starts and only sixth at Wolverhampton last month, but he was returning from a break and was slowly away; could be sharper for that latest outing and he ran well in third over C&D in April; this three-time C&D winner is capable of having a big say.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Well beaten on both runs this year (5f), here most recently, and a major turnaround is necessary; however, the form of the stable catches the eye and she won over C&D last October; back up in trip today; interesting.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap (Div II)
OwnerName: The Horse Watchers 13 And Michael Dods
Spotlight: Won over 7f here in March and not beaten far when fourth of seven at Ayr (7f, good to firm) in May when last seen; however, he's returning from a three-month break and 7f is probably his optimum trip.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap (Div II)
OwnerName: L Bond/Sheikh Aymen Jawad Al Hamandi/Ptr
Spotlight: Made it 0-11 for the year when down the field here (7f) a fortnight ago; however, he was in pretty good heart previously and his last win came over C&D last October; not written off.

RaceName: Community Fund For Elmbridge Handicap
Spotlight: Made all in first-time cheekpieces (retained since) at Chepstow (1m, good to firm) last month and close second there since; also effective elsewhere (albeit unraced here) and he holds solid claims.

RaceName: Community Fund For Elmbridge Handicap
Spotlight: His losing run is up to 13 and he's not as good as he was, but off a reduced mark he's run well to be third on his last three outings, over C&D (good to firm) last time after a two-month break; could be thereabouts.

RaceName: Community Fund For Elmbridge Handicap
Spotlight: Returned from a break with an all-the-way win under James Glennon at Lingfield (7f, good) in June and he's fine at 1m; however, he's finished merely seventh on his last two starts and has to raise his game.

RaceName: Community Fund For Elmbridge Handicap
Spotlight: Changed hands for 9,000gns last month and comfortably exploited a reduced mark on last Thursday's stable debut at Nottingham (1m, good to firm), where he was odds-on in a first-time visor (retained); this C&D winner is ahead of the handicapper under a penalty and should be tough to beat.

RaceName: Community Fund For Elmbridge Handicap
Spotlight: Five-time turf winner who posted two AW wins in autumn 2024 off higher marks than today's; lightly raced since, however, with patchy form, and others have more obvious claims.

RaceName: Community Fund For Elmbridge Handicap
OwnerName: P And Mrs L Rowe And John Turner
Spotlight: Inconsistent and he blew the start here two runs ago, but with the visor left off (same today) he returned to form with a good second over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago; can be in the mix if backing up that latest run.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Dam 2m2f hurdle winner, half-sister to useful bumper and 2m-2m1f hurdle/chase winner Whatswrongwithyou, out of unraced half-sister to useful bumper/2m hurdle winner No Where To Hyde; market best guide on debut.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Solid fourth in a 2m Clonmel maiden hurdle on debut in May and best of two efforts since on latest when staying-on third of 11 in C&D bumper last month (good); one to consider.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Kingston Hill mare is second foal of a bumper/2m hurdle winner, a half-sister to useful 2m4f hurdle/chase winner Ballyarthur; headgear combination on for debut, probably best watched.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Remote fourth in this race last year (good) and soundly beaten both starts since on softer ground.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Cheaply bought Mizzou mare is sister to 2m6f hurdle winner Nothing Hectic; dam unraced half-sister to useful 2m chaser The Wicketkeeper and useful French jumper La Zingarella; successful debut in March in 3-finisher Oldcastle mares' point-to-point (soft-to-heavy); interesting if any market support arrives on rules debut, encouraging jockey booking.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Nothing as yet in three bumpers.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Hillstar mare is half-sister to seven winners inc Sizing Tennessee (high-class bumper and 2m-3m2f hurdler/chaser), Mount Ida (smart bumper and 2m-3m2f hurdle/chase) and Bargy Lady (bumper and 2m-2m6f hurdle/chase); dam 8.7f Flat and 2m1f hurdle/chase winner; nicely-bred debutante from top yard, demands utmost respect.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Valirann filly cost 1,400euros as a foal; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to 3m hurdle/chase winner Lunar Contact, out of unraced sister to Champion Bumper and smart 2m2f-2m4f hurdler/chase Briar Hill; debutante worth a market check

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: E3,000 F (E5,000 vendor 3yo); fourth foal; closely related to 2m hurdle winner Crying Lightning; dam unraced half-sister to useful winners Guitar Pete (2m-2m5f hurdle/chase) and Somethingwonderful (bumper/2m hurdle); some late headway on Ballinrobe debut in May; potential improver.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Every chance when falling two out in Lisronagh point-to-point before bolting up at Necarne; subsequently bought for 32,000GBP and has to be respected on bumper debut (having been ballotted out at Galway last week).

RaceName: Chepstow Plant International Supports Chepstow Centenary Handicap
Spotlight: Better for the tongue-tie going on in his last three races and won comfortably here in late June (6f, good to firm); could deal with the 8lb rise.

RaceName: Chepstow Plant International Supports Chepstow Centenary Handicap
Spotlight: 6f winner on good to soft for previous yard which she left for 21,000gns; fourth of six on stable debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) but only beaten a little over 2l in a messy race.

RaceName: Chepstow Plant International Supports Chepstow Centenary Handicap
Spotlight: Successful handicap debut at Southwell (6f AW) in April and has performed generally okay in the meantime without looking ahead of his mark; however, has to be feared in a race with no depth.

RaceName: Chepstow Plant International Supports Chepstow Centenary Handicap
Spotlight: His form had dipped but in first-time blinkers he emerged from off a strong pace to collect by a length at Salisbury (6f, good to firm); Charlie Tucker rides again off a 3lb rise; chance if the headgear continues to help.

RaceName: Fegentri World Championship (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Capable dual-purpose performer won a nice pot on the Flat at Killarney last August off 4lb lower; stepped forward from below-par seasonal return when a 4.75l fifth at Fairyhouse on latest (3l behind Not Just Any Eagle); eased 2lb and place chance.

RaceName: Fegentri World Championship (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Four-time winner, most recently here over 1m4f in May 2025; 2lb lower here and shaped like coming back to form when a 1.75l third at Fairyhouse (1m6f) on latest; stays this trip and enters calculations now.

RaceName: Fegentri World Championship (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: 2m AW winner has run well in defeat at times on turf; not disgraced in the Northumberland Vase at Newcastle on latest when beaten 4.25l; more needed back on the grass.

RaceName: Fegentri World Championship (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Point-to-point and hunter chase winner; modest form in three Flat maidens including over C&D; not obviously well treated for this handicap debut and probably best watched for now.

RaceName: Fegentri World Championship (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Four-time winner on long losing run; shaped okay when fifth at Naas on penultimate, but didn't build on that when beaten 7l over 1m5f here on latest; needs more upped in trip.

RaceName: Fegentri World Championship (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Won a soft-ground novice for Charlie Johnston in September 2023 but has come up dry since; back from mammoth layoff with moderate run in a Limerick claimer on debut for this yard in June; may need another run or two to hit top form.

RaceName: Fegentri World Championship (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Best on good ground and shaped nicely on seasonal return over 1m4f (good) at Roscommon when a 2.5l second; failed to fire at Ballinrobe on latest but didn't get her ground; could rebound on this more suitable surface.

RaceName: Fegentri World Championship (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Dual-purpose sort has got the hang of things in recent starts; won over hurdles at Wexford and backed that up with a close third on the Flat at Tramore (2m, good); place claims at the very least again off the same mark.

RaceName: Fegentri World Championship (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Long-standing maiden tailed off in first two runs for this yard last summer and hasn't been seen since; miles out of the handicap here and impossible to make a case for.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won a Listed race in France (1m4f, heavy) in April 2023, but not seen since successful over hurdles for Robert Eddery in July 2024; market should be revealing on his debut for another new yard (same owner) after such a long absence.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum
Spotlight: Looked a progressive sort last year (3-5) and ran well to finish runner-up on his Goodwood reappearance (1m6f, good) in May; soft ground the likely reason for his dismal effort at Epsom (1m4f) on Derby Day and better expected if taking to the AW.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Has won four races and still looks to be improving; ran better than it looked when fifth of 13 in the Rosebery on his reappearance at Kempton (1m3f, Polytrack) in March and looked in need of a return to further when fourth of 11 at Chester (1m2f, good) in May; off three months, but has won fresh; high on list.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Made a winning stable debut at Meydan (12.5f, good) in January, but held in three starts since; ran with credit in one previous go on the AW, but others are more compelling.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Has been smart in his time and is now 10lb lower than when winning the 2023 Cambridgeshire; record on the AW as a 3yo read 121, but a leap of faith is required based on his two efforts since returning from a long absence (and wind surgery).

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 10-30 on the AW including two wins over this trip at Kempton; recent turf form has been patchy, but he is 2lb lower than when last successful on the AW so by no means written off.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Had no problem with the longer trip when winning on his Chester reappearance (1m2f, good to soft) in June and now bids for a four-timer off a 4lb higher mark; should stay this far on breeding and high on list in current mood.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Recorded narrow wins on his final start of last year at York (1m2f, good) and on his Chester reappearance (1m2f, good) in May, but held in last two starts including when behind King's Code back at Chester; half-brother to an AW winner, but he needs to bounce back.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 2-5 last year, his latest success coming on his first start since being gelded, at Lingfield (1m2f, Polytrack) in December (form has worked out well); 6lb higher on this return, but still respected especially if market positive.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Five wins since July last year including one over 1m4f here; cheekpieces seemed to work well at York (1m2f, good) last time and a player in his hat-trick bid despite a 6lb rise.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Just 2lb higher than when winning over 7f here in April, but is unraced beyond 1m1f and this looks a tough race in which to prove his stamina.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Seems to have an aversion to anything away from soft ground on turf, but is proving consistent on the AW (2312); one for the shortlist.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Infrequent winner but is 2-4 on Tapeta, his latest win coming from 3lb lower at Newcastle (1m2f) last September; could go well at a price.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap
Spotlight: Dual AW winner whose most recent success came at Beverley (1m4f, good to firm) last month; below his best at Chester last time but drops back into class 6 company with claims.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap
OwnerName: A Sinclair, David Carroll & G Gibson
Spotlight: Sole win came at Navan (1m2f, good) last April when trained by Joseph O'Brien; ran his best race since joining current stable when second of five at Carlisle (1m3f, good; first-time visor) last month but his task will now be to back that up.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time winner, most recently at Wetherby (1m2f, good to firm) last June off a 5lb higher mark; however, he's struggled in four starts since and now has a bit to prove; down in class.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap
Spotlight: Got off the mark, tongue tied for the first time, at Kempton (1m) last April but he's struggled in three starts since returning from a 400-day absence; others have stronger claims.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap
OwnerName: Spiers & Hartwell Ltd & Mrs E Evans
Spotlight: Three-time AW winner (9.5f-1m4f), most recently last October off 3lb higher; has run well in two starts at Ffos Las since returning from a 95-day break, latest when second of four behind an improving rival three weeks ago; makes the shortlist back on the AW.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win on the AW came at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) in December; has posted some good placed efforts since and left the impression he's still in form when sixth of 13 there over 1m3f last time; can be slowly away but is considered.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap
Spotlight: Two wins, including one over this C&D in May off a 5lb lower mark than today's; respectable effort when fourth behind younger rivals over 1m6f at Southwell ten days ago and won't mind this drop back in trip; could go well.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark when winning at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) in June and followed up at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) next time; has since left James Ferguson; holds good claims off this 6lb higher mark on his stable debut.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time winner (8.5f-1m2f) who is often slowly away; ran well when third at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) last time in a race won by a subsequent winner; has since left Iain Jardine having been bought for £5,000; has the hood removed for his stable debut and has stamina to prove.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap
Spotlight: Won at Pontefract (1m2f, good) last July but he was well beaten on his next two starts for Paul Attwater, and finished down the field on his stable debut at Kempton (1m3f) in June; needs to take a big step forward from that first start for 230 days.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time AW winner and he's 9lb lower than for the most recent success; never featured from off the pace at Wolverhampton (9.5f, AW) two weeks ago but it would be no surprise to see him bounce back now returning to 1m3f.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice for the Crisford stable but he struggled for Mike Smith, and has failed to beat a rival in each of his two starts for current stable; lots to prove.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden who has run below market expectations in three starts this year; however, he did shape better than the bare result over 1m6f two weeks ago, taking up the running 4f out before his stamina gave way; should be suited by this drop back in trip.
